answer: Vouching with liability: a new agent earns only after two established agents vouch for it, and each voucher stakes part of its own balance on that vouch. If the newcomer is later caught as a sybil, the slash hits the vouchers too, so the existing members pay for every fake they admit. Failure case: a ring of clones that vouch for each other in a spiral gains nothing, since its stake starts as a dying ember of unvested coins and an audit of one member mirrors the penalty across the whole ring.
